thread:
anna: thinking about adding a 'Run staging evaluation' button in the rollout flow — runs a dry simulation against recent traffic and outputs predicted fallback hits / latency impact. useful for PMs and SREs? :thinking_face:

mike: big yes on the idea. key Q: does it actually change routing or just simulate? i'd prefer simulate + optional dry-run that records what decisions would have been taken.

sasha: agree. two modes: 'preview' (no side effects, only metrics) and 'dry-run' (decision engine executes but routing is not changed, audit logs produced). that covers safety and signal validation.

priya: need to be crystal on what data we show. if dry-run records decisions, we must redact user content in audit logs and keep TTL for logs short by default (30d). otherwise compliance asks will come.

anna: yep. default retention 30d, orgs can opt-in to longer. UI should surface which fields are redacted.

mike: UX question: where to surface the results? inline on the rollout page + downloadable csv and a small visualization: a stacked bar with % fallthrough vs fallback-by-reason (error, quota, circuit-breaker, model-mismatch).

sasha: telemetry-wise we should emit an event per simulation run: {"type":"staging_eval","config_id":...,"result_summary":...} but with hashed identifiers, not user ids. also annotate which model variant was attempted.

priya: also add a warning banner if the staging_eval predicts > X% fallback to lower-tier variant. default X=5%? open to debate.

mike: 5% seems low. customers with bursty traffic might see noise. maybe 10% threshold for auto-warning, 25% for strong red flag.

anna: okay propose: warn at 10%, urgent at 25%. make thresholds editable per-org.

sasha: implementation detail: we can replay sampled request traces through the routing decision engine. sampling rate default 5% of recent 24h traffic. you can bump sample size in advanced panel. big runs should be async and show progress.

priya: sampling note: default 5% might miss rare error triggers. add a checkbox: 'include error-biased sampling' which up-samples traces that hit 5xx or long-tail latencies.

mike: nice. for the audit we should record the decision tree path (policy matches, rule id, percentile that triggered) — but export as structured but redacted. example snippet payload we can show in UI: 

```
{
  "request_id": "<redacted_hash>",
  "policy_eval": ["route:primary","check:latency>200ms -> fallback:variant-b","rule_id":"rb-123"],
  "outcome": "fallback",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-01T15:12:00Z"
}
```

mike: above looks good. avoid keeping raw prompt text.

anna: permissions: who can run staging eval? by default org-admin + product-owners, but add granular permission so SREs and engineers can run without admin if org wants. need auditable "who ran it" entries.

sasha: UI microflow: small button next to 'Start rollout' -> modal: choose mode (preview/dry-run), sample size, error-bias checkbox, retention policy for logs, run. show estimate of time and a link to view previous runs.

priya: add guardrail: if selected sample > 50k requests then require a confirmation and a soft cost estimate because replaying is expensive. also rate-limit runs to 1 concurrent per-org.

mike: integration point: Console should call internal API endpoint POST /rollouts/:id/staging_eval. payload shape minimal. response should return job id and a tiny preview. we'll add websocket for progress messages.

sasha: i can sketch API contract. also need a background worker that runs evaluation in a sandboxed runtime to avoid touching live routing.

anna: can we include a tiny 'what-if' toggle that shows what would have happened if we had enabled a specific degrade mode (e.g., 'quiet-degrade' vs 'graceful-handback')?

mike: yes — replay can be parameterized by candidate fallback mode. nice for comparing tradeoffs.

priya: final must-have: exportable audit bundle (jsonl) for p95 engineering investigations. each bundle row should reference hashed ids and policy rule names. retention controlled by the UI setting chosen at run time.

anna: cool. action items: @sasha make initial API + modal wireframe. @mike estimate infra cost and concurrency limits. @priya write redaction + retention policy doc. i'll wire up copy/alerts and thresholds in product doc.

sasha: on it — will post a quick Figma link when done.

console-bot: deploy-notice: experiment flag "staging_evals_enabled" toggled off in prod by default. enable via /flags for staging orgs. :robot_face:

mike: thanks — we'll iterate on thresholds after a couple of pilot runs. :thumbsup:
